messages:
aoife_vendor: Hi - invoice `2026-IE-3172` was issued with 23% VAT. Our bookkeeping says this should be reverse-charged (buyer IE entity) or reported via OSS depending on how you classified the supply. Can you reissue without VAT and add our VAT: IE1234567A? Also flag: our payments team is asking if Redwood will gross-up for a potential 1.5% local withholding for digital services. Contract mentions gross-up but no numbers.

rachael_finance: Thanks Aoife. Which Redwood legal entity is on the invoice (US or Redwood EMEA)? If it's Redwood EMEA we can apply reverse-charge. Please attach invoice PDF and your PO. For gross-up: we'll need the contract clause and TRC to consider.

aoife_vendor: Invoice shows "Redwood Technologies Ltd" (Ireland office) as buyer. PDF attached. Contract clause: section 12 says "supplier may request gross-up for taxes imposed on payments." No cap.

neil_tax: Note: If billed to Redwood Ireland and buyer is VAT-registered, supplier should issue invoice net with reverse-charge reference. OSS only applies for B2C cross-border supplies; not for B2B SaaS. On withholding: Ireland rarely withholds on cross-border SaaS, but if a local jurisdiction (e.g., a sub-supplier in another country) claims 1.5% we need TRC + treaty analysis. Without TRC we generally withhold per local law.

sam_legal: Quick read of section 12: permissive but ambiguous. We don't accept open-ended gross-ups. Contractually, gross-up requires (1) statutory withholding, (2) TRC or equivalent evidence, and (3) prior written approval from Redwood. Please ask vendor to upload TRC and a formal calculation of requested gross-up.

rachael_finance: Action list: 1) Reissue invoice with reverse-charge and vendor VAT ID once buyer VAT is validated. 2) Do not gross-up by default. 3) Request TRC and a line-by-line gross-up calc if they want us to consider it. 4) Place payment hold until docs received. @billing-bot queue reissue.

billing-bot: Reissue job created: original `2026-IE-3172` -> draft `2026-IE-3172-RC` (job id 2333001400). Draft note: "Reverse charge 1 VAT to be accounted for by the customer. Buyer VAT ID: IE999888777." Payment hold set pending TRC.

aoife_vendor: Thanks - we'll upload TRC if we can get one from treasury. For the reverse-charge wording, can you paste exact text so our AP matches?

rachael_finance: We'll use: "Reverse charge 1 VAT - VAT to be accounted for by the customer (Article 194 EU VAT Directive). Customer VAT ID: IE999888777." Also include contact for billing disputes.

neil_tax: If TRC arrives showing non-Irish residency and treaty relief, we can consider paying gross and reclaiming WHT. Otherwise we will apply withholding per local rule and remit. Remember formula: gross = net / (1 - wht_rate). Use that for vendor's calc.

aoife_vendor: Understood. We'll try to get TRC within 2 business days. If not possible, please proceed with whatever local withholding is required so we can plan cashflow.

billing-bot: Draft reissued and emailed to accounts@vendor.ie. New invoice id: `2026-IE-3172-RC`. Status: awaiting TRC.

rachael_finance: Thanks everyone. Closing for now; we'll reopen thread if TRC arrives or legal requests changes.
